messages:
Priya: Heads-up — rolling out new Dedicated instance types (h100x2 and l4x4) in us-west-2 and eu-central-1 this week. Short summary + actions below.
Marco: ETA for reservations? Will existing Dedicated customers be forced to migrate?
Aisha: Reservation window will open Wed 09:00 PT. Migration is optional but recommended if you care about latency/throughput improvements.
Priya: Reservation link (internal): https://internal.redwood.net/dedicated/reserve. Pricing highlights: h100x2 ~ +25% unit cost vs current a100 profile; l4x4 ~ -10% vs a10g for typical batching workloads.
Nate: FYI there's a short KB in the product playbook with perf numbers and common config tweaks — will drop a link in #eng-platform shortly.
Tom: Any known runtime quirks (KV cache, warmup, quantization differences)?
Priya: Good Q. Early H100 kernels show a KV-cache warmup penalty on very short sequences. Workaround: set min_batch=2 for the first 5–10 minutes post-deploy or use prefix-caching where possible. Also watch transient memory pressure on large-context models.
Priya: Rollout config we'll use:```
# rollout config
regions: [us-west-2, eu-central-1]
instance_types: [h100x2, l4x4]
auto_refresh: true
min_batch: 2
migration_window: "2024-06-20T09:00Z - 2024-06-26T09:00Z"
```
deploy-bot: [auto] Capacity commit opened: 120 h100x2 GPUs (us-west-2), 80 l4x4 GPUs (eu-central-1). Reservation period starts 2024-06-19T16:00Z.
Aisha: We'll flag customers with active Dedicated contracts and >10k req/day for outreach. SEs should expect an email template in the shared drive.
Marco: If a customer declines migration, do we keep their existing allocation?
Priya: Yes — no forced migrations. Customers keep current reservations. We’ll offer migration assistance and an incentive credit for early movers.
Nate: I'll add a perf dashboard tile (per-model latency/cost) and a per-route rollout toggle in Console so teams can canary their traffic.
Tom: Any ops actions for oncall? Playbook updates?
Aisha: Update runbook sections: "capacity surge" thresholds and "fallback to a100" policy. Also a short incident checklist for H100 warmup regressions.
Priya: Customer-facing comms: email + KB + migration playbook on Monday AM. Internal embargo until Friday 17:00 PT — please don't forward outside Redwood. Ping me for embargoed copies. :lock: :mailbox_with_mail:
Marco: Thanks — will schedule a quick sync with Solutions Eng and Account Managers tomorrow.
Priya: Thanks team. Will post the SE/customer templates and final reservation link here when live. :rocket:
